name: scePadInit
notes: libpad init; binds padman SIDs 0x80000100/101 (IOP_AND_IO.md lists 0x4b0944; Ghidra function entry is 0x4b0948)

name: scePadRead
notes: (port,slot,buf)->len; copies 32B from padman ring (+0x60 = len). THE raw pad read hook point

name: scePadGetState
notes: returns 6 (STABLE) when ready; 99 if port not open

name: powf
notes: used as pow(|stick|,2.0) in stick response

name: PadMgr_Open
notes: scePadInit + PortOpen(0,0,this+0x500) PortOpen(1,0,this+0x600) + alloc 2 rings of 8x0x20 samples

name: PadMgr_Update
notes: virtual slot +0x1c of the pad manager. Per-frame: GetState/SetMainMode, scePadRead x2 ports into ring, per sample: buttons ^ 0xffff, stick bytes -> ProcessStickAxis, button edge events, accumulate axis floats at this+0x44c

name: PadMgr_DispatchGuiKeyEvents
notes: table 0x4e98d0 (15x{id,mask,name}); pad button edges -> GUI event mgr (DAT_005565d8) keydown(id)/keyup(id|0x10000); ids are DIK scancodes or 0x100/0x101 = L/R MOUSE

name: PadMgr_DispatchActionEvents
notes: table 0x4e9800 (17x{action,mask,name}); pad button edges -> device callback (this+0x410) (keymap[action],action,pressed,time); also feeds cheat detector

name: PadMgr_ProcessStickAxis
notes: (this,byte,|delta|,stickIdx 0=lx 1=ly 2=rx 3=ry): v=(b-128); if b in [0x51,0xaf] and |delta|<4 -> 0; f=v/128 clamp +-1; out=sign*pow(|f|,2)*scale -> this+0x498+idx*12+4

name: PadMgr_PollToRing
notes: alternate poller (no callers; scePadRead into ring)

name: InputDev_GetAxis
notes: vslot +0x54: returns float axis[i] (this+0x44c+4*i). THE game-side analog read

name: InputDev_Ctor
notes: base: keymap u16[512] at +8, callback +0x410/+0x414, vptr +0x434

name: InputDev_SetCursorPos
notes: vslot +0x10c; clamps to screen DAT_005565c8+0xf8/+0xfc; cursor x,y at device(this)+0

name: Game_OnInputCommand
notes: callback registered by 0x243e88; (cmd 0x40xx, actionId, pressed, time): big switch = all digital gameplay commands

name: Player_AxesToDigitalCommands
notes: axes 2/3/4 -> digital cmds 0x4019/0x4020 (fwd/back, axis2 +-0.1), 0x4014/0x4013 (axis3 +-0.2), 0x4011/0x4012 (axis4 +-0.25) via Game_OnInputCommand

name: Player_GatherInput
notes: (player, float out[5]): out0=-axis0 (turn), out1=axis1, out2=axis2, out3=axis3 clamped, out4=axis4; also scripted nudges (DAT_004fbb0c/10); callers 0x271e18 0x274c18 0x311220

name: Camera_UpdateLook
notes: (player, float limits[], bool dragonMode): reads axes 0,1,5; updates camera obj (FUN_00283ac8) pitch +0x84, yaw-offset +0x90, rates +0x9c/+0xa0/+0xa4; rotates player heading via FUN_0013ee90; dt = *(DAT_005565d4+0x24); 2.2 rad/s factor

name: Player_CameraLookTick
notes: calls Camera_UpdateLook with limit 0.6283 rad (foot) / 1.0472 (dragon), then applies pitch to head/torso bones

name: Options_ApplyStickAxisMapping
notes: for stick 0..3: SetStickAxisMap(2,stick,|cfg[+0x7c+4*stick]|) + scale (sens pow for axes 0,1; invert if negative or Y-invert)

name: Options_LoadStickScheme
notes: copies scheme table PTR_DAT_00511ef8/00511f08[scheme] into options+0x7c

name: Options_ApplyButtonScheme
notes: first applies DIK->command table 0x54b6c8 (56 entries), then pad button->command scheme tables 0x511ed8/0x511ee8

name: Gui_PollMouseState
notes: GetCursorPos->DAT_0051013c/40, IsActionDown(0x100)/(0x101) -> L/R mouse flags DAT_00510108 (1/2 down, 4/8 pressed, 0x10/0x20 released)

name: Engine_Tick
notes: calls PadMgr_Update (vslot 0x1c) once per frame via DAT gp-0x7f68
